name: Aditya Singh
intro: I build backend systems and the ML that runs on them: event-driven APIs, real-time pipelines, and models that ship behind a service instead of staying in a notebook.
about: I'm a final-year B.Tech student in Electronics and Communication Engineering, specialising in AI/ML, at Netaji Subhas University of Technology, Delhi.

Most of my work sits where backend engineering meets machine learning: event-driven pipelines, real-time APIs over WebSockets, auth that holds up with many users, and models that are deployed behind a service rather than left in a notebook.
Outside the code I run the tech side of DevComm, NSUT's developer community, and organise events for a few college societies.
open_to: Software Engineer, Backend, Full-stack and AI/ML roles. Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Mumbai, Chennai or remote.
